title: ResourceSaver fails to correctly save modified empty array properties
body:
### Tested versions

4.5.1.stable.official [f62fdbde1]

### System information

Godot v4.5.1.stable - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated AMD Radeon RX 9060 XT (Advanced Micro Devices, Inc.; 32.0.22029.9039) - AMD Ryzen 7 5700X 8-Core Processor (16 threads) - 15.91 GiB memory

### Issue description

When using `ResourceSaver.save()` to save a custom Resource, if an array property is cleared (becomes an empty array), the saved `.tres` file lacks that property, causing it to revert to the default value instead of an empty array when reloaded. I don't think this should have happened. (I've found that Dictionary has the same issue)

### Steps to reproduce


## step1: Create a new custom resource
```gdscript
class_name MyResource
extends Resource

@export var arr: Array

func _init() -> void:
	arr = ["Z"]


func change_arr():
	arr = ["A", "B", "C"]

func clear_arr():
	arr = []

```
## step2: Test
```jdscript
extends Node2D
# Called when the node enters the scene tree for the first time.
func _ready() -> void:
		var resource1 = MyResource.new()
		var resource2 = MyResource.new()
		
		resource1.change_arr()
		resource2.clear_arr()
		
		ResourceSaver.save(resource1, "res://res1.tres")
		ResourceSaver.save(resource2, "res://res2.tres")
		
		var load1 = load("res://res1.tres")
		var load2 = load("res://res2.tres")
	
		print("load1: ", load1.arr)
		print("load2: ", load2.arr)
```

## Output:
```
load1: ["A", "B", "C"]
load2: ["Z"]
```

## Saved Resource Files
res1.tres:
```
[gd_resource type="Resource" script_class="MyResource" load_steps=2 format=3 uid="uid://6ssh5s6mjrb1"]

[ext_resource type="Script" uid="uid://dy8dcy2etvhv1" path="res://new_script.gd" id="1_v4dld"]

[resource]
script = ExtResource("1_v4dld")
arr = ["A", "B", "C"]
```
res2.tres:
```
[gd_resource type="Resource" script_class="MyResource" load_steps=2 format=3 uid="uid://f2koxra480sc"]

[ext_resource type="Script" uid="uid://dy8dcy2etvhv1" path="res://new_script.gd" id="1_kydr1"]

[resource]
script = ExtResource("1_kydr1")
```
